EXPLANATION: The spectrum lacks OH/NH stretches (3200–3600 cm⁻¹), disfavoring alcohols and amides (candidates 1, 3, 6, 10). It also lacks a strong 2100–2300 cm⁻¹ band expected for diazo/azide or Si–H/P–H systems (candidates 2, 7). A very strong band at 671 cm⁻¹ is consistent with a C–S ring stretch typical of thioethers/oxathiolanes, and multiple strong bands at 1041 and 1058 cm⁻¹ align with C–O and C–F stretches expected for a fluorinated oxathiolane. Bands at 1247 and 1293 cm⁻¹ can arise from C–O–C asymmetric stretches/ring modes; CH stretches at 2984/2947/2913 and CH bending at 1465 fit aliphatic frameworks (GFQ-003). Overall, the pattern best matches a fluorinated 1,3-oxathiolane (candidate 5).
